# twenty_object

Reads object metadata, including built-in objects, without changing it or reading CRM records. Requires the `DATA_MODEL` settings permission because this provider selects the guarded icon field. Specify exactly one of `object_id` or `name_singular`. Names match case and whitespace exactly; UUID matching is case-insensitive. Ambiguous names require a native UUID.

## Example usage

```terraform
data "twenty_object" "company" {
  name_singular = "company"
}
```

To select by UUID, replace `name_singular` with `object_id`. Use the [object resource](../resources/object.md) to manage workspace-custom objects. A false `is_system` value does not establish custom ownership; built-in applications can own non-system objects.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_singular` (String) Singular name. As a selector, matching is exact and case-sensitive without trimming. Specify exactly one of object_id or name_singular.
- `object_id` (String) Native nonzero object UUID selector. UUID matching is case-insensitive. Specify exactly one of object_id or name_singular.

### Read-Only

- `application_id` (String) UUID of the application that owns the object.
- `description` (String) Object description, or null.
- `icon` (String) Icon identifier, or null.
- `id` (String) Native object UUID.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the object is active.
- `is_system` (Boolean) Whether Twenty marks the object as system metadata. False alone does not establish custom ownership.
- `label_plural` (String) Plural display label.
- `label_singular` (String) Singular display label.
- `name_plural` (String) Plural object name.
